text: DSH Context OS 是面向 DSH Web 的上下文组合插件：用户可浏览、配置并排序代码、文档、技能或会话历史等连接器，为不同任务选择所需资源后启动独立 DSH 会话。框架通过统一的上下文贡献和事件接口装配信息、路由连接器操作。适合需要按任务切换上下文来源或执行资源的 DSH 用户；运行需 Node.js 24.9+ 和兼容的 DSH 版本，所读代码没有显示必需 API key。

DSH Context OS lets DSH Web users combine code, documents, skills, and session history as connectors for an agent task. It assembles context, routes connector events, and starts a separate session. Requires Node.js 24.9+ and compatible DSH; no required API key appears in reviewed code.

dsh-context-os README · DSH Context OS：DSH Context OS is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Choose the environment, code, conversation history, documents and other services for this run. Each service supplies context and handles the interactions it owns. The framework composes their contributions around the agent loop.

dsh-context-os README · DSH Context OS：[ReAct](https://react-lm.github.io/) combines reasoning and acting. Our slogan expresses an architectural thesis: keep that loop general, and make its connection to the world composable.

**Status:** experimental `0.2.0`. The composition runtime and drag-and-drop Web UI work today. The complete mode uses the included launcher with a pinned DSH build. Service-wide resource auditing and agent-assisted configuration are next steps. See [current scope](#current-scope).

dsh-context-os README · Start with the run：Many agent products organize everything around a workspace, a persistent session, a skill directory or a fixed set of tools. Those are useful product choices. They also become architectural assumptions: where files live, how history is restored, which instructions are loaded, and how outside services can respond.

We choose a smaller foundation: **an agent loop running with a particular context composition**.

dsh-context-os README · Start with the run：For a given model and runtime configuration, the context assembled for the model—and the information and capabilities it can reach—are central product variables. Context includes instructions, history, task input, capability descriptions and observations returned from the world. Improving it means supplying the right information at the right time, with access to the right resources.

This leads to two responsibilities:

dsh-context-os README · Start with the run：- **The framework defines how context is composed and how events are delivered.**
- **Service providers decide what to contribute, when to contribute it, and how their resources work.**

A document platform can offer guidance, search, editing, permissions and persistence together. An input method, a log stream or a history recommender can participate through the same boundary. Skill and MCP remain useful integration formats; they do not define the framework's service model.

dsh-context-os README · Start with the run：This project develops the proposal in [Context assembly and feedback as the framework boundary](https://github.com/weijiafu14/dsh/blob/main/articles/02-context-connectors.md).

dsh-context-os README · Three layers, one feedback loop：**One connector owns one complete service.** Its instructions, callable capabilities, execution feedback, persistence and cleanup stay together. A sandbox service can contribute system guidance and file/shell capabilities through the same protocol as a document service contributes editing guidance and document operations.

dsh-context-os README · Three layers, one feedback loop：The framework owns contribution identity, ordering, validation and assembly. DSH owns the native loop. Construction and service dependencies use DSH/Cordis; a repository provider that needs an execution provider uses those existing dependency mechanisms.

A run follows the same path for every service:

dsh-context-os README · Three layers, one feedback loop：1. Selected connectors initialize and contribute instructions, capabilities and, where applicable, coherent history.
2. Before each model step, the framework combines their current contributions into the next input.
3. The model requests an operation. The framework routes it to the connector that owns it.
4. That service operates on its resources and returns an answer, possibly with updated context for a later step.
5. Records and settlement events return to the services for persistence and cleanup. They can also contribute context for subsequent work.

dsh-context-os README · Three layers, one feedback loop：The same boundary supports both initial assembly and ongoing feedback. Loading knowledge on demand, receiving a new log entry and returning a tool result all fit into it.

dsh-context-os README · Replace the execution environment as a complete service：Moving a coding agent from a host machine to a sandbox is difficult when file reads, file writes, directory inspection, environment checks, shell execution and workspace instructions are spread across the agent's implementation. Redirecting commands alone can leave filesystem checks or environment descriptions pointing at the original host.

With Context OS, an execution provider owns this whole resource boundary:
section: Replace the execution environment as a complete service

text:
dsh-context-os README · Replace the execution environment as a complete service：| Responsibility | What the environment connector supplies |
| --- | --- |
| Describe the environment | System or user context explaining paths, available software and operating constraints |
| Inspect and change resources | Callable descriptions and implementations for its file, directory and command operations |
| Return observations | Results and context updates from the environment actually used |
| Manage the lifecycle | Provisioning or attachment, provider-side authorization, cancellation handling and release |
section: Replace the execution environment as a complete service

text: dsh-context-os README · Replace the execution environment as a complete service：Switching from a local provider to a sandbox provider changes the selected service. The core still composes instructions and routes owned requests. Compatible repository and document services keep their contracts; dependencies remain explicit.
section: Replace the execution environment as a complete service

text: dsh-context-os README · Replace the execution environment as a complete service：**The migration becomes an implementation of the environment service contract, with a smaller change surface and reusable tests.** The provider still implements the actual isolation, resource access and lifecycle. Merely describing a sandbox in a prompt does not create one.
section: Replace the execution environment as a complete service

text:
dsh-context-os README · Continue a conversation across machines：When persistence and resume logic are inseparable from a coding agent, continuing elsewhere can require moving local session files, reproducing directory layouts and adapting the agent's recovery path.

Here, selected history is one source of context. A session provider loads it, converts it to the accepted representation, receives new records and persists the result. Its backend can be local storage or a remote service.

Continuation becomes:

dsh-context-os README · Continue a conversation across machines：```text
Choose history + choose this run's services + start the loop
```

That makes it possible to keep a shared history service while changing machines or execution environments, or to reuse the same starting history with a different set of resources. DSH still maintains the active loop's working state; the provider owns where persistent history comes from and where it goes.

dsh-context-os README · Continue a conversation across machines：For example, a provider built on this contract can save a laptop run to shared storage, then load that history on another machine for a run using a cloud sandbox. History transfer belongs to the session service; access to the new execution resources belongs to the environment service.

dsh-context-os README · Continue a conversation across machines：A portable session needs coherent call/result relationships, required attachments and resolvable resource references. The provider owns those details. The current runtime accepts one coherent native replay history; multiple conversations can be supplied as reference material after provider-side conversion. Live process migration and conflict-free concurrent synchronization require additional service implementations.

dsh-context-os README · Let users configure the run itself：Users should be able to choose combinations such as:

| Run | Selected services |
| --- | --- |
| Fix a bug | Task input + repository + sandbox + selected history |
| Review a design | Task input + team documents + architecture knowledge + history |
| Investigate an incident | Task input + log source + code service + incident history |
| Explore an alternative | The same starting history + a different execution or document service |
section: Let users configure the run itself

text: dsh-context-os README · Let users configure the run itself：The Web composer already supports dragging available connectors into a run, editing their configuration and starting a separate native DSH conversation. Developers can construct the same composition through the core API. Agent-assisted selection is a planned way to produce that configuration.
section: Let users configure the run itself

text: dsh-context-os README · Let users configure the run itself：“Any combination” means any compatible selection: dependencies, permissions and contribution conflicts still apply. Sources may update the context during a run; replacing the selected connector set creates a new composition.
section: Let users configure the run itself

text: dsh-context-os README · Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify：A provider can own authentication, permission checks, resource versions, quotas and usage measurement alongside its read/write operations. It can expose a whole service without squeezing its lifecycle into a skill file or tool description. The framework supplies a consistent integration boundary.
section: Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify

text: dsh-context-os README · Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify：That also makes changes more local. Replace one service, hold the others constant, and verify the same user scenario. The repository tests exercise this by switching a complete service between local files and HTTP while keeping the framework and other connectors unchanged.
section: Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify

text: dsh-context-os README · Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify：An architecture knowledge service can maintain module responsibilities, data flows and invariants as a shared map for humans and agents. Service contracts and their validation can then reflect actual reliability, latency and cost requirements, while people set the business priorities and acceptable risk.
section: Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify

text: dsh-context-os README · Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify：This follows the engineering goals in [Architecture for AI-driven development](https://github.com/weijiafu14/dsh/blob/main/articles/01-architecture.md): explicit responsibilities, smaller change surfaces, realistic validation and replayable cases. Captured inputs, contributions and outcomes can support a growing regression corpus; identical configurations alone do not guarantee identical model outputs.
section: Make services independently useful—and changes easier to verify

text: dsh-context-os README · Visibility, resource accounting and context limits：The intended product contract is understandable before, during and after a run: which services are selected, what they contribute, and which resources they read or change. Context should be inspectable as part of the run configuration, alongside the task and model settings.
section: Visibility, resource accounting and context limits

text: dsh-context-os README · Visibility, resource accounting and context limits：The current framework attributes contributions and owned calls to connector instances. Providers can record their own operations. A unified read/write ledger, shared billing protocol and interception of arbitrary shell/network side effects are **future work**. For example, a Git service can report a pull as a read of its remote repository and a push as a write; the pull can still write a local working copy. Attribution must specify the resource concerned.
section: Visibility, resource accounting and context limits

text: dsh-context-os README · Visibility, resource accounting and context limits：Context-window limits remain. A connector can contribute a small index and retrieve detailed material only when needed; the model need not receive every resource in full at startup. Budgeting, selection and compaction policy belong at the runtime boundary and can evolve independently of resource services. Today the underlying runtime provides compaction; Context OS does not yet expose a general pluggable budget/compaction policy.
section: Visibility, resource accounting and context limits

text: dsh-context-os README · Visibility, resource accounting and context limits：This is what **OS** means in the project: a common boundary between the loop and resource services, where composition policies can evolve while providers keep their own responsibilities.
section: Visibility, resource accounting and context limits

text: dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：A connector implements `{ id, events, handle(event) }`. The five runtime events are:

dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：| Event | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `run/initialize` | Initialize the selected composition; contribute starting context and history |
| `agent/prepare-step` | Refresh context before the next model step |
| `tools/execute` | Execute an operation owned by this connector and answer its request |
| `session/event` | Observe a durable native record; save it or contribute future context |
| `run/settled` | Finish per-turn work; `closing: true` also marks final resource release |

dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：Sources can additionally use their own names, such as `documents/changed` or `logs/new`. A log source does not have to pretend that a user sent a chat message to deliver an event.

Handlers return four kinds of contribution:

dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：| Operation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `put` | Set or update an owned current instruction, callable description or execution projection |
| `remove` | Withdraw an owned current contribution |
| `append` | Add input messages; during initialization, provide coherent native replay records |
| `answer` | Return the result of the connector's own pending request |

dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：The framework combines instruction fragments by role and preserves call/result relationships. Fragment keys are scoped to their connector, selection order is stable, and conflicting callable names, replay owners or execution projections are rejected. Providers convert their own business formats. Natural-language contradictions still require sensible service configuration.

dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：A current-state update affects the next prepared request. `put/remove` can invalidate an earlier cache prefix; `append` explicitly grows the history. Records remain immutable, and settlement feedback does not silently start another model turn.

For an existing run containing the [complete document service](examples/documentService.ts):

dsh-context-os README · A small connector protocol：`send()` always acknowledges admission. `completed` waits for execution, child work and persistence. The full example keeps instructions, lazy guidance, reads, writes, record collection, saving and cleanup in one connector. See the [protocol and integration reference](docs/protocol.md) for registration, ownership, concurrency and host integration.

DSH_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/pinned/deepseek-harness npm run verify
npm run export:source
```

The standalone source archive has been built outside the integrating application. Its 51 package tests cover composition, actual DSH execution, instruction replacement/removal, replay, cancellation, persistence, live feedback and service replacement. Tests requiring the native bridge run separately rather than being counted as successful skips. Consumer type checks also pass.

dsh-context-os README · Development and evidence：Installed-package browser validation covers DSH Web drag-and-drop, custom providers, skills, MCP, cold history and PTC. The same composer has also been exercised through JoyGen's WebSocket/runtime/storage integration. dsh-context-os README · DSH Context OS：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

> **ReAct is all you need.**  
> **Everything is a context connector.**

**用完整、可替换的资源服务，自由组合每一轮 Agent 运行。**

DSH Context OS 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件。用户为这一轮选择执行环境、代码、会话历史、文档等服务；每个服务提供自己的上下文，处理属于自己的交互；框架围绕 Agent loop 统一装配这些贡献。

[ReAct](https://react-lm.github.io/) 将推理与行动结合。这里的 slogan 表达的是一种架构主张：保持通用的运行循环，让它与外界的连接可以自由组合。
dsh-context-os README · DSH Context OS：**当前状态：**实验版 `0.2.0`。上下文组合运行和 Web 拖拽界面已经可用，完整模式通过随包启动器配合固定版本的 DSH 运行。统一资源审计、通过 Agent 对话辅助配置等能力属于下一步，详见[当前能力](#当前能力)。

dsh-context-os README · 从一轮运行出发：很多 Agent 产品围绕工作区、持久会话、技能目录或固定工具集组织能力。这些是有用的产品选择，也逐渐变成了架构里的默认前提：文件放在哪里，历史如何恢复，说明从哪里加载，外部服务怎样参与运行。

我们选择更小的基础：**一轮采用特定上下文组合的 Agent loop 运行。**

在模型和运行配置给定的情况下，模型收到的上下文，以及它能够获取的信息和资源能力，是决定产品表现的关键变量。上下文包含说明、历史、任务输入、可调用能力描述，也包含外界返回的观察结果。改善上下文，意味着在合适的时机提供合适的信息，并让 Agent 能够访问正确的资源。

由此得到两条清晰的分工：

- **框架规定上下文如何装配、事件如何交付。**
- **服务提供方决定贡献什么、何时贡献，以及自己的资源如何工作。**

一个文档平台可以完整提供使用说明、搜索、编辑、权限与持久化。输入法、日志流、历史推荐服务，也可以通过同一切面参与。Skill、MCP 仍是有用的接入形式，框架里的服务模型可以覆盖比这些形式更完整的能力。

上下文装配与校验 · 事件分发"] **一个 connector 对应一个完整服务。**这个服务的说明、可调用能力、执行反馈、持久化和收尾放在一起。沙箱服务贡献系统说明与文件、Shell 能力，文档服务贡献编辑说明与文档操作，都使用同一套协议。 框架负责贡献的身份、顺序、校验与装配，DSH 负责底层运行循环。实例构造和服务依赖沿用 DSH/Cordis：例如 Git 提供方依赖执行环境提供方，使用已有的依赖机制完成协作。
section: 三层架构，一套反馈机制

text:
dsh-context-os README · 三层架构，一套反馈机制：每个服务都通过同一条链路工作：

1. 选中的连接器初始化，贡献说明、能力，以及需要装配的合法历史。
2. 每次模型执行前，框架把各服务的当前贡献组合成下一次输入。
3. 模型请求某项操作，框架把请求交给拥有这项能力的连接器。
4. 服务操作自己的资源，返回结果，也可以贡献后续步骤需要的上下文。
5. 运行记录和收尾事件反馈给服务，由它们保存数据、完成业务收尾、释放资源；也可以为后续工作贡献上下文。

开始前的装配与运行中的反馈，使用的是同一个切面。按需获取知识、收到一条新日志、返回一次工具执行结果，都可以纳入这套机制。
section: 三层架构，一套反馈机制

text:
dsh-context-os README · 把执行环境作为完整服务替换：将一个 Coding Agent 从宿主机迁移到沙箱，往往很复杂：文件读写、目录检查、环境检测、Shell 执行、工作区说明散布在 Agent 的不同实现里。只把命令执行转到远端，文件检查或环境描述仍可能指向原来的宿主机。

在 Context OS 中，执行环境提供方完整拥有与这个环境有关的资源边界：

| 职责 | 环境连接器提供什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 介绍环境 | 以 system 或 user 上下文说明路径、已安装软件和运行约束 |
| 查看与修改资源 | 提供文件、目录、命令等操作的能力描述与实现 |
| 返回观察结果 | 从实际使用的环境返回结果与上下文更新 |
| 管理生命周期 | 创建或连接环境、服务端鉴权、处理取消与释放资源 |

从本地环境切换为沙箱环境，改变的是这一轮选中的服务。框架仍然装配说明、分发所属请求；契约兼容的仓库、文档服务可以继续使用，依赖关系也保持明确。
section: 把执行环境作为完整服务替换

text: dsh-context-os README · 把执行环境作为完整服务替换：**迁移工作因此收敛到环境服务契约的实现，改动范围更小，相同场景可以复用测试。**真正的隔离、资源访问与生命周期仍由提供方实现；在 prompt 里介绍一个沙箱，不会自动产生沙箱。
section: 把执行环境作为完整服务替换

text:
dsh-context-os README · 跨机器继续同一段工作：当持久化与 resume 路径紧密嵌在 Coding Agent 内部时，换一台机器继续工作，往往要迁移本地会话文件、重建目录布局，再适配 Agent 自己的恢复逻辑。

在这里，选定的历史只是上下文的一种来源。会话提供方加载历史，将它转换为框架接受的表示，接收新记录并保存结果。后端可以是本地存储，也可以是远端会话服务。

继续工作就可以表达为：

```text
选择历史 + 选择这一轮的服务 + 执行 Agent loop
```

因此可以保留共享的历史服务，同时更换机器或执行环境；也可以从同一份起始历史出发，组合不同资源探索另一条路径。DSH 仍维护当前循环需要的运行状态，会话提供方负责持久历史从哪里来、保存到哪里去。

例如，基于这个契约实现的提供方，可以把笔记本上的运行结果保存到共享存储，再在另一台机器加载这段历史，选择云端沙箱继续工作。历史传递由会话服务负责，新执行资源的访问由环境服务负责。
section: 跨机器继续同一段工作

text: dsh-context-os README · 跨机器继续同一段工作：可迁移的会话还必须包含合法的调用与结果关系、必要附件，以及可以解析的资源引用。这些由提供方负责。当前运行时接受一份完整、合法的原生重放历史；多个会话可以由提供方转换后作为参考上下文贡献。运行中进程迁移、多人并发写入时的同步与冲突处理，需要相应服务继续实现。
section: 跨机器继续同一段工作

text:
dsh-context-os README · 让用户配置“这一轮”本身：用户应当能够选择这样的组合：

| 本轮任务 | 选中的服务 |
| --- | --- |
| 修复一个 Bug | 任务输入 + 仓库 + 沙箱 + 指定历史 |
| 评审设计方案 | 任务输入 + 团队文档 + 架构知识 + 会话历史 |
| 排查线上问题 | 任务输入 + 日志来源 + 代码服务 + 事件处理历史 |
| 探索另一种方案 | 相同的起始历史 + 不同的执行环境或文档服务 |

Web 界面已经支持把可用连接器拖入本轮、编辑配置，并创建独立的 DSH 会话。开发者也可以通过核心 API 构造相同的组合。让用户通过对话请 Agent 辅助选择连接器，是后续生成这份配置的一种交互方式。

“任意组合”意味着在依赖、权限和贡献冲突规则下自由组合。已经选中的来源可以在运行中更新上下文；替换连接器集合，则创建新的组合运行。
section: 让用户配置“这一轮”本身

text:
dsh-context-os README · 让服务独立演进，让改动更容易验证：提供方可以把鉴权、权限判断、资源版本、配额和用量统计，与自己的读写操作放在一起。一个完整服务的生命周期因此有了明确归属，可以通过统一切面接入框架。

改动也更容易局部化：替换一个服务，保持其他服务不变，用同一个用户场景验证行为。仓库中的测试实际完成了这种替换：将完整资源服务从本地文件后端换成 HTTP 后端，框架和其他连接器保持不变。

架构知识服务还可以持续维护模块职责、数据流和系统约束，成为人与 Agent 共用的系统地图。服务契约与验证要求可以匹配实际的可靠性、延迟、成本要求，由人确定业务优先级和可接受的风险。

这也落实了[《未来 AI 研发体系：架构篇》](https://github.com/weijiafu14/dsh/blob/main/articles/01-architecture.md)中的工程目标：明确职责、控制影响范围、验证真实场景、持续积累可回放案例。记录输入、上下文贡献和结果，可以逐步形成回归案例库；相同配置本身并不保证模型每次输出相同。
section: 让服务独立演进，让改动更容易验证

text:
dsh-context-os README · 看得见的组合、资源读写与上下文上限：我们希望产品在运行前、运行中、运行后都能让用户看清：这一轮选择了哪些服务，它们贡献了什么，读写了哪些资源。上下文应当和任务、模型配置一起，成为可以查看和理解的运行配置。

目前框架已经能将上下文贡献与所属调用关联到连接器实例，提供方也可以记录自己的操作。统一读写账本、跨服务计费协议，以及对任意 Shell、网络副作用的拦截，是**后续目标**。例如 Git 服务可以把 pull 标记为对远端仓库的读取，把 push 标记为写入；pull 同时可能写入本地工作副本，统计时必须明确资源归属。

上下文窗口仍然有限。连接器可以先贡献一个小索引，等需要时再获取详细内容；资源多，不意味着启动时必须把所有正文塞给模型。预算分配、信息选择与压缩策略属于运行时边界，可以随框架演进，而资源服务继续保持自己的职责。目前压缩由底层运行时提供，Context OS 尚未开放通用的预算与压缩策略插件接口。

这就是名称中 **OS** 的含义：在运行循环与资源服务之间建立共同边界，让装配策略可以演进，让服务提供方完整管理自己的能力。
section: 看得见的组合、资源读写与上下文上限

text:
dsh-context-os README · 一套小接口：连接器实现 `{ id, events, handle(event) }`。运行时提供五个事件：

| 事件 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `run/initialize` | 初始化本轮组合，贡献起始上下文与历史 |
| `agent/prepare-step` | 在下一个模型步骤之前刷新上下文 |
| `tools/execute` | 执行属于本连接器的操作，并回答对应请求 |
| `session/event` | 收到已经产生的原生记录，可以保存，也可以贡献后续上下文 |
| `run/settled` | 完成本轮业务收尾；`closing: true` 还表示最终释放资源 |

来源也可以使用自己的事件名，例如 `documents/changed`、`logs/new`。日志到达是来源事件，不需要伪装成“用户发来了一条聊天消息”才能交付。

处理事件后，返回四种上下文贡献：

dsh-context-os README · 一套小接口：| 操作 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `put` | 设置或更新自己拥有的当前说明、可调用能力描述或执行投影 |
| `remove` | 撤销自己拥有的当前贡献 |
| `append` | 追加输入消息；初始化时也可以提供完整的原生重放记录 |
| `answer` | 回答属于本连接器的在途请求 |

框架按角色组合说明片段，并保留调用与结果关系。片段 key 按连接器隔离，选定顺序稳定；冲突的调用名称、历史重放归属、执行投影会被拒绝。业务数据的格式转换由提供方完成。自然语言说明之间的语义矛盾，仍需要服务配置者合理处理。

当前状态的更新作用于下一次准备好的请求。`put/remove` 可能使较早位置之后的缓存失效；`append` 明确表示增加历史。已产生的记录不可改写，收尾反馈也不会悄悄开启另一轮模型运行。

假设当前运行已装配[完整文档服务示例](examples/documentService.ts)：

dsh-context-os README · 一套小接口：```typescript
const receipt = await run.send(
  'documents/changed',
  { policy: '采用更新后的评审规则。' },
  'documents',

`send()` 始终确认事件已被接纳，`completed` 等待执行、子任务和持久化完成。完整示例把说明、按需指南、读写、记录收集、保存和释放放在同一个 connector 中。注册方式、归属、并发与宿主集成的细节见[协议参考](docs/protocol.md)。

dsh-context-os README · 当前能力：| 本版已经提供 | 需要集成方实现或后续建设 |
| --- | --- |
| 统一事件与上下文贡献、归属隔离和冲突检查 | 统一资源读写账本、任意网络与 Shell 副作用拦截 |
| DSH Web 拖拽组合器、可复用的宿主 UI | 通过 Agent 对话辅助选择连接器 |
| 原生执行工具、Skill、MCP、会话历史、子 Agent 的适配，以及 PTC 执行投影 | 面向具体生产环境的沙箱、远端会话和企业服务后端 |
| 独立框架入口与完整文档服务示例 | 通用上下文预算、压缩策略插件 |
| 已验证的更新、撤销、冷恢复、服务替换和持久化行为 | 跨机器迁移正在执行的进程、多写入方会话同步 |

Skill、MCP 适配用于承接已有集成，新服务可以直接实现连接器协议。宿主安全策略和服务方鉴权继续生效；本包不提供不可信插件代码隔离，也不会自动记录任意 Shell 命令的全部外部影响。

dsh-context-os README · 安装与运行：需要 **Node.js 24.9+**，以及已经构建好的 DSH [`22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/22ddee3792402c3e70ec5f86a63c3e3e895a2f60) 版本，版本标签为 `0.2.1-rc.3`。只匹配 npm 版本号不够。首个版本为 `dsh-context-os@0.2.0`。

从 npm 安装到兼容的 DSH Web profile：

dsh-context-os README · 安装与运行：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-os@0.2.0 --ignore-scripts --config.auto-install-peers=false -w
"${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/node_modules/.bin/dsh-context-os" --dsh-root /absolute/path/to/pinned/deepseek-harness --profile web
```

[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/weijiafu14/dsh-context-os/releases) 也提供插件安装包和独立源码包。如需自行构建，在本项目源码目录运行：

```sh
DSH_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/pinned/deepseek-harness npm run build
npm pack
```

将生成的包安装到兼容的 DSH Web profile：

dsh-context-os README · 安装与运行：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-context-os-0.2.0.tgz --ignore-scripts --config.auto-install-peers=false -w
"${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/node_modules/.bin/dsh-context-os" --dsh-root /absolute/path/to/pinned/deepseek-harness --profile web
```

启动器在 DSH 启动前装入经过版本核对的上下文准备与接纳适配，保留原 DSH 安装文件。完整事件驱动模式通过这个启动器启用。进入 Web 后，打开 **上下文组合**，选择连接器、输入任务并开始运行。
dsh-context-os README · 安装与运行：公开入口分别是：DSH 插件 `dsh-context-os`、组合核心 `/core`、兼容适配 `/compat`、React 组合器 `/ui`。运行时 peer 包由兼容的 DSH 提供，共享 UI 支持 React 18、19。插件使用 Web/desktop 客户端契约，独立 Electron 安装发行版尚未单独验证。

dsh-context-os README · 开发与验证：```sh
DSH_SOURCE_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/pinned/deepseek-harness npm run verify
npm run export:source
```

源码包已经在集成应用之外独立构建。51 项包测试覆盖上下文组合、实际 DSH 执行、说明更新与撤销、重放、取消、持久化、运行中反馈和服务替换。需要原生适配的测试单独执行，跳过项不会被算作通过；消费方类型检查也已通过。

安装包的浏览器验证覆盖 DSH Web 拖拽、自定义提供方、Skill、MCP、冷启动历史与 PTC；同一组合器也通过了 JoyGen 的 WebSocket、运行时和存储集成验证。这些验证使用确定的模型响应与本地企业接口测试替身，实际执行运行时、工具与浏览器；不代表已经验证所有提供商或真实企业鉴权。
